title: Agreement problem
text: Guides on both days are excellent. We think that should be equipped with audio system so that everyone in the group will hear them clearly. And we were upset that the pickup time changed and not according to our booking. Shocked us.  Attractions and explanations were perfect we enjoyed the tour at the end. We came together with friends and family.   We have horrible experience from the airport pick up from Suntransfer. We weren't not able to find the driver at airport and we need to take 2 taxis to go to Hotel
author: laikit_t
